geometry: 70mm diameter x 140mm height cylinder defaults; see config
planeStrainConvention: 2D: F_zz=1; sigma_zz evolves constitutively; qJ2 and qtriaxial differ; not axisymmetric
stressConvention: compression positive CSV; native tension positive Cauchy stress
axialStrainConvention: MPM: prescribed platen engineering strain; separate measured particle-domain extent diagnostic; homogeneous: computed F_yy
plasticStrainConvention: VM plastic_strain CSV column unavailable; mc-kappa is accumulated sqrt(2/3)||dev delta epsilon_p||; mc-plastic-strain-native is 1.5*mc-kappa
platenWorkConvention: rectified added platen force work, with cell-pressure work separate; not signed energy closure
yieldConvention: VM max_yield_excess CSV column unavailable; mc-yield-residual-kirchhoff-pa=max_{i!=k}((1+sin phi)tau_i-(1-sin phi)tau_k-2*eta*c*cos phi), tau=J*sigma_Cauchy, tension-positive; signed Pa
drainage: total/effective stress without pore fluid or pore-pressure coupling

materialDiagnosticsFields.name: mc-kappa
materialDiagnosticsFields.definition: accumulated equivalent plastic strain sqrt(2/3)||dev delta epsilon_p||

materialDiagnosticsFields.name: mc-kappa-max
materialDiagnosticsFields.definition: maximum accumulated equivalent plastic strain sqrt(2/3)||dev delta epsilon_p||

materialDiagnosticsFields.name: mc-plastic-strain-native
materialDiagnosticsFields.definition: accumulated sqrt(3 J2(dev delta epsilon_p)); 1.5 times mc-kappa

materialDiagnosticsFields.name: mc-yield-residual-kirchhoff-pa
materialDiagnosticsFields.definition: signed corrected 6-plane MC yield residual, tension-positive Kirchhoff stress

materialDiagnosticsFields.name: mc-friction-rad
materialDiagnosticsFields.definition: current evolving friction angle in radians

materialDiagnosticsFields.name: mc-friction-deg
materialDiagnosticsFields.definition: current evolving friction angle in degrees

materialDiagnosticsFields.name: mc-dilation-rad
materialDiagnosticsFields.definition: current evolving dilation angle in radians

materialDiagnosticsFields.name: mc-plastic-volume
materialDiagnosticsFields.definition: accumulated plastic volumetric strain trace(delta epsilon_p)

materialDiagnosticsFields.name: mc-plastic-work-j-m3
materialDiagnosticsFields.definition: accumulated plastic work density per unit current volume

materialDiagnosticsFields.name: mc-softened-indicator
materialDiagnosticsFields.definition: 1 when variant is :HS and kappa exceeds peak_kappa, else 0

terminationNote: Completed 30 matched frames (0.00% to 14.26% axial strain, 2224 updates) covering pre-peak hardening, peak (6.52%), and full post-peak softening plateau; at frame 30 (>14.3% strain), a platen-corner particle enters tensile mean stress where strict c=0, psi=0 zero-dilation apex rejection triggers as designed.
